pieces.Text: 1/day, you can cheat death. If you would be killed by a melee attack, ranged attack, or an effect that requires a saving throw, you are instead reduced to -1 hit points and knocked unconscious, but are stable. You appear dead (though a character who succeeds at a DC 25 Heal check or who uses an ability such as deathwatch can tell he is not), but become conscious 1 minute later unless awakened sooner.
